verdict.rationale: Gitea is documented as a self-hosted Git service, and community users deploy it as a Git server whose contributors clone repositories, which implies standard Git client access. The pack never explicitly documents clone, pull, or push over HTTPS or SSH. missing for 10: explicit documentation of HTTPS and SSH Git transport, standard-client compatibility for clone/pull/push, hands-on corroboration of push and pull over each protocol

support.subject: As a developer, I can clone, pull, and push repositories with any standard Git client over HTTPS or SSH

citations.quote: Free, self-hosted Git service under the MIT license.
This makes it convenient for individual developers or small teams to set up and manage their own Git services.
Sysadmin deployed Gitea as a Git server for a small project with 8 users.
